scope: Local-terminal follow-up; user authorized lifting protected UI/core boundary. No release publication in this step.

commits.subject: Throttle TUI frame-draw error reports to once per run (#15287)
commits.reason: Targets the absent Warp Agent TUI runtime; no corresponding Lite frame driver.

commits.subject: Fix report_error! demotions of typed errors into extra: (APP-5522) (#15298)
commits.reason: Typed Sentry reporting fixes target disabled/removed reporting; Lite core already uses local logging. No reporting infrastructure restored.

commits.subject: Downgrade key-binding responder-chain report_error! to log::error! (#15299)
commits.reason: Lite already used local logging; preserve upstream full error-chain formatting.

commits.subject: Fix Sentry data exposure: PII/typed-content leaks missed by #15298's merge race (APP-5522) (#15300)
commits.reason: Sentry typed-error change and removed AI credentials; Lite does not use the affected reporting path.

commits.subject: Add a right-click behavior setting: context menu (default) or paste (#15365)
commits.reason: Opt-in right-click paste across input, prompt, blocks and alt screen; Shift and mouse ownership preserved. Existing scroll callback signature retained.

commits.subject: Restore report_error! for flex infinite-constraint, guarded to report once (#15390)
commits.reason: Once-per-run flex diagnostic adapted to local AtomicBool guard, without restoring reporting infrastructure.

commits.subject: Explain Shift+right-click when the right-click setting pastes (#15392)
commits.reason: Shift+right-click help text included.

commits.subject: Reduce monomorphization in warpui_core update and spawn paths (#15453)
commits.reason: Non-generic update bookkeeping and boxed spawn paths adapted to Lite Box<dyn AnyView>.

commits.subject: Terminate TUI when host terminal disconnects (#15421)
commits.reason: Host disconnect lifecycle targets absent warp_tui/runtime, not the GUI terminal PTY.

commits.subject: Recover the renderer after Windows RDP device loss (#15566)
commits.reason: WGPU device-loss guard before acquiring a frame; Windows runtime not available.

commits.subject: Pin cosmic-text to the fix that forbids Hack as a fallback donor (APP-5492) (#15569)
commits.reason: Pinned cosmic-text fallback donor fix; native macOS uses CoreText.

commits.subject: Extract secret detection into secret_redaction and regex_dfas crates (#15462)
commits.reason: Secret detection crate extraction is structural; retained local detection does not require new crates.

commits.subject: Show live cloud connection indicator on third-party agent rich input (#15625)
commits.reason: Cloud connection status chip; excluded cloud behavior.

commits.subject: Fix em_width panic when a glyph has no bounding box (#15705)
commits.reason: Glyph bounds failure uses positive advance or finite fallback; regression tests retained.

commits.subject: Add ViewHandle::try_update and use it to guard shared session retention (#15695)
commits.reason: New try_update API is consumed by removed/shared-session agent retention; no local-terminal behavior requires it.

commits.subject: [REMOTE-3086] Make text in Thought dropdowns selectable and copyable (#15691)
commits.reason: Selection behavior is for the disabled AI Thought dropdown.

commits.subject: Switch WASM team picker in place instead of opening a window (REV-2280) (#15740)
commits.reason: WASM team picker is outside native local terminal scope.

commits.subject: Guard reversed glyph bounds in smart_select (#15772)
commits.reason: RTL smart-select guards reversed visual glyph bounds; regression test retained.

commits.subject: [APP-5825] Bypass layout cache for editor text (#15831)
commits.reason: Uncached editor text layout with font fallback requests; persistent placeholder cache retained. Adapted to Lite warpui imports.

commits.subject: Adds first-class Grok Build support (#14228)
commits.reason: Local Grok identity, rich-input strategy, OSC9/OSC777 and user-triggered plugin install adapted; no cloud or telemetry activation.

commits.subject: Add Windows backdrop material dropdown (#15879)
commits.reason: Windows backdrop dropdown and legacy Acrylic migration adapted to local settings initialization; no new cloud subscription.

commits.subject: [APP-5720] Conversation usage popover in the agent input footer (#15946)
commits.reason: Agent usage/cost UI; excluded billing/embedded-agent behavior.

commits.subject: Split is_headless into is_gui/is_headless and rename AppBackend::Headless to Windowless (#16034)
commits.reason: Headless/backend renaming is structural and tied to Agent TUI; no local GUI behavior improvement.

commits.subject: Recognize TIFF images in the macOS clipboard (#16055)
commits.reason: macOS TIFF clipboard detection included. Removed warp_tui attachment path not imported.

commits.subject: fix: update rmcp to 2.2.0 to resolve CVE-2026-64684 (#16092)
commits.reason: Not directly portable: Lite is on the rmcp 0.10 fork with SseClientTransport and OAuth handling in app/src/ai/mcp/templatable_manager/native.rs; upstream migrates 1.6 to 2.2 using crates/mcp, which Lite does not contain. Requires a separate transport/API migration or removal of the unused platform dependency. Upstream labels this a security fix; remediation and non-applicability are not claimed.

commits.subject: [Chat][MCP] Send the MCP server's Warp-side identity in MCPContext (#15942)
commits.reason: Warp-side MCP identity for embedded agent; no local terminal improvement.

commits.subject: Support Kiro CLI as a first-class coding agent (#16243)
commits.reason: Local Kiro identity, kiro-cli/kiro detection, icon and rich input adapted; no notification plugin or cloud activation.
